High has three repetitions and low two, at later calendar times; settings, cache, load and time can be confounded. Equal nominal effort is not proof of equal reasoning budget. Compare observed quality and measured token/time distributions when choosing a channel configuration; equal observed quality is not statistical equivalence.

Size labels are frozen planned bins, never reassigned from observed token usage. Field checks are correlated diagnostics, not independent samples. Full JSON success additionally requires protocol completeness and exact schema.

source_pass is final hidden semantic grading; episode_success additionally requires a final model response before cap/transport failure. Turn cap is censored, never silently promoted to episode success. Tool times sum model-call times and exclude local tool/grader runtime, matching runner measurement.

Only explicitly listed interrupted-pair attempt IDs are excluded from primary code workflows; their raw terminal calls and unknown-usage journal starts remain in all-attempt accounting. Administrative collector interruptions are not provider failures. Gateway status/duration never substitute for missing client protocol, latency or usage.

Usage-based USD list-equivalent estimate only, not exact billing or subscription deductions. Request start in Asia/Shanghai selects weekday peak 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, else off-peak. Per-million input/cache/output: peak 0.30/0.006/1.20, off 0.15/0.003/0.60. Prompt tokens include cached tokens: subtract cache before uncached rate. Completion tokens already include reasoning; never add reasoning a second time. Missing usage/cache/time leaves estimate unknown. Unreturned/interrupted usage can remain unknown.

Timestamp reconstruction uses all recorded terminal calls across phases. It is a lower bound whenever in-flight/administratively interrupted calls lack client terminal times. Nominal concurrency_per_provider is runner metadata, not proof of total simultaneous link/provider load. Half-open intervals exclude calls ending exactly when another begins. Collector recovery metadata, not apparent journal overlap alone, determines administrative interpretation.

Workflow throughput uses runner-recorded chosen first/repair or episode responses. Every terminal attempt remains in request totals. Requests not yet referenced by terminal workflows are separately listed; pending or abandoned state and any additional overhead require review, not automatic deletion.
